title: You-block surface stops at the end of the text instead of spanning the content width
observed: The raised background behind 'explain the change' covers only the text cells; the rest of the row is the page background, so short prompts look like highlighted text, not a message block.
expected: Design renders the user message as a block-level surface (#241f18) across the full content width with 10px (~1 col) inner padding.
